oracle_check: disjoint visible static pixels where (x//8+y//8)%3==0, including visible thin; no re-fit, robust trimming or GT-based model choice
oracle_validity: finite positive transformed inverse depth, no near/far clamp; report missing held rays
oracle_interpretation: privileged diagnostic of remaining shape error, not deployable calibration, training supervision or a proven global error bound
same_pixel_D1_comparison: original D1 positive depths intersect held visible static and positive oracle depths

report: all and strong pair sign violations, pair coverage and GT static-visible purity, equal-depth false strong ordering, invalid/missing, per-view and aggregate; original D3 direct-use gate unchanged
